answer: Picture a walled garden where every agent must be covered by an independent underwriter who posts copper-hard collateral and forfeits it if that agent is later proven a sybil. Each underwriter inspects behavior before insuring anyone, and every policy ties up real capital, so premiums rise as a single buyer seeks many. A fleet of N fakes needs N separately funded policies from distinct insurers, each one a pearl of locked collateral at risk. Honest singletons pay once; attackers pay N times over and climbing.
